 O R D E R
The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioners are the accused 1 to 3 in Crime No.852/2023 of the Poochakkal Police Station,
Alappuzha, which is registered against them for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 r/w. Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. When the bail application came up for consideration on 01.12.2023, this Court passed an interim order by directing the petitioners to appear before the investigating officer within five days from the date of order in response to Section 41A notice and subject themselves to interrogation by the investigating officer.

4. Heard; Sri.M. Sasindran, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Smt. Seetha S.,
learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents.
5.

The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, BAIL APPL. NO.10794 OF 2023 submitted that,
pursuant to the interim order dated 01.12.2023, the petitioners were arrested in another crime.
They were interrogated by the investigating officer and the investigating officer has filed a refer report before the jurisdictional court.
Therefore, the petitioners' presence is not required.
6. The submission of the learned Public Prosecutor is recorded.

7. Resultantly, the application is disposed of by making the interim order dated 01.12.2023 absolute,
subject to the following conditions:
(i) The petitioners shall co-operate with the investigation and make themselves available for interrogation and for the purpose of investigation as and when the Jaison Joy vs State Of Kerala on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185554549/
